ShellExecuteW/reveal run on the host STA thread after the current update unwinds instead of a background thread (recorded adaptation).

WM_ACTIVATE's synthesized ModifiersChanged posts to the foreground queue rather than running in-handler (WM_ACTIVATE inside CreateWindowExW/ShowWindow would re-enter App.OpenWindow before the logical window exists; the app still sees one event per activation after the reset).
WM_DWMCOLORIZATIONCOLOR is not in the pin — the ticket's mention is stale; the pinned theme mechanism is WM_SETTINGCHANGE/ImmersiveColorSet, which is what was implemented.
